job.title: Architect* im Bereich E-Commerce #11246
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your e-commerce architect role needs strong platform, API and integration design – my focus for 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell. What I bring in concrete terms:

– Solution design with design patterns and data modeling
– Headless OCC REST APIs and API migrations
– PIM / ERP / MDM integration pipelines; technical guidance via code reviews

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Solution Design & Integration | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java & REST APIs
tailoring.summary: E-commerce engineer with 5+ years designing and implementing solutions on enterprise B2B and B2C platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in solution design, design patterns, data modeling, microservices, headless OCC REST APIs and PIM / ERP / MDM integration architecture with Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders. Engineered API migrations, led query performance tuning, executes CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2 and guides developers through code reviews. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Cegeka combines long-term customer partnerships with broad technology delivery, so e-commerce architecture there has to be robust and maintainable. I want to bring my experience designing APIs, integrations and commerce functionality to a company that builds lasting solutions for its customers. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.

en.subject: Application: Architect E-Commerce #11246
en.hook: An e-commerce architect has to make platform, APIs and integrations fit together so the business can grow on a stable base. That is the problem space I have worked in for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I design and implement functionality, headless APIs and data pipelines on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) following platform best practices and design patterns.

bullets.label: Solution design & best practices
bullets.text: Designed and implemented functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on Hybris 2211 following platform best practices and design patterns.

bullets.label: API architecture
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) and engineered API migrations for customer account structures, improving stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Integration architecture
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub and resolved SAP ERP / MDM integration bottlenecks.

bullets.label: Technical leadership
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, provided technical guidance to junior developers and led database query refactoring that reduced response latency.

en.logistics: I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation about how I can contribute to Cegeka's e-commerce solutions.
